revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready.
Vote - AcceptText - Multiple improvements. I suggest making ὅνπ[ερ] ἔδωκάς μοι or ὃν π[α]ρέδωκάς μοι alternate readings--as Balamoshev says, there is no omicron after rho.
General - For l. 3, one should consider either ὅνπ[ερ] ἔδωκάς μοι or ὃν π[α]ρέδωκάς μοι. The papyrus appears to have ονπ[]ρεδωκας, there is no space for an omicron in between.
General - Thank you. I agree with ων is better than ως. For l. 10, I was considering ̣ ̣ ̣κ̣υρον σου, but have no solution either (κύριον? κυρὸν? Κῦρον?), hence I left it as is.

Vote - AcceptText - I am happy to say that almost all the corrections are secure (but I'd prefer a discursive treatment). I only have reservations about lin3 (there's improvement, but we still don't have an intelligible text; τ̣[ῶν] φ̣ρ̣ο̣υρῶν in lin10 is also impossible, but I don't have a solution), and the suggested ὡς in lin14 (this type of sigma is not common in this period and cf. -ων in the line above. || Revise the presentation of the correction in lines 15–16, to keep σου at the start of 16 inside the correction block. || The full-stop in lin13 should be removed.
Submit - Multiple corrections.

Commit - Mutliple corrections: l. 5 περσ̣έ̣α̣ν Σ̣οτούχων̣ (BL 5.63 Περσ̣έ̣α̣ν) => π̣εν̣αα̣π̣οτουχων̣ (probably a name, but περσεαν is very unlikely). The same applies to the subsequent part: π̣ά̣τῳ σ̣ο\υ/ => .3σωο̣ι (the line ends with an iota); l. 11 ἐπεὶ τοῦς => ἐπειστολὰς (l. ἐπιστολὰς), γράφοντας <:ἔχει|reg|ἔ̣χ̣ο̣ι => γράφοντός̣ μοι; <:ἐπὶ|reg|ἐπεὶ:> => ἐπὶ; l. 13 ὀ̣ρθῶς => οὕτ̣ως; l. 14 ἀπώλ̣ε̣σ̣εν => αὐτῷ μὲν, ὧν => ὡς; l. 15 τάξ\ει/τῇ πόσ|σου (l. πόσ|ου) => τὸ κτῆνός | σου; l. 18 <:ἤρκεις|reg|ἠρκ\ε/ες:> => <:ἦρκας|reg|ἦρκες:>.
Finalized - This is good to go.
